about.quote: I went from flipping houses to helping neighbors — one family at a time.
about.subtitle: Meet your bilingual El Paso realtor.
about.paragraph1: I grew up watching my grandmother devotedly care for the homes she worked hard to save for; those same homes later became her only source of retirement income. About 6 years ago, I decided to take a leap of faith (with some careful planning) and follow her example by investing in fixing and flipping a house.
about.paragraph2: Today, I own and manage several properties in our city. The success I found inspired me to become a realtor, allowing me to help my neighbors become homeowners, too... and maybe inspire a few to venture into investment properties.
about.paragraph3: Whether you're buying your first home, selling to start a new chapter, or exploring investment, I'll walk you through every step — in English or Spanish.
about.ctaTitle: Let's make your next move together.
about.imageAlt: Portrait of Angelina Gándara, El Paso real estate agent

buyers.title: Buying in El Paso, without the guesswork.
buyers.subtitle: Clear guidance from your first conversation to your closing — in English or Spanish.
buyers.step1Body: We start with a conversation about what you need — budget, timing, and the neighborhoods that fit your life.
buyers.step2Body: I'll curate homes that actually match your criteria, so you're not scrolling through hundreds of listings.
buyers.step3Body: We'll tour the shortlist together and narrow in on the right home — fast, because good homes move quickly here.
buyers.step4Body: From offer to closing, I'll handle the paperwork and negotiations and keep you informed at every step.
buyers.statsDisclaimer: Figures are approximate market estimates for illustration. Ask for current market data.
buyers.faq1Q: I'm a first-time buyer. Where do I start?
buyers.faq1A: With a conversation. We'll talk through your budget, get you connected with a lender, and map out a plan — no pressure, just clarity.
buyers.faq2Q: Do you work with Spanish-speaking buyers?
buyers.faq2A: Absolutely. I'm fluent in Spanish and can guide you through the entire process — paperwork and negotiations included — in your language.
buyers.faq3A: In minutes, day or night. Speed is my promise; you'll never be left waiting on the home you want.
buyers.faq4Q: How do I compete in a fast market?
buyers.faq4A: With preparation. We'll get you pre-approved and ready to move quickly, so when the right home appears, your offer is strong.
buyers.faq5Q: How long does the process take start to finish?
buyers.faq5A: It varies, but most buyers go from first conversation to closing within a few weeks once we find the right home. I'll keep you on track the whole way.
buyers.formSubtitle: Tell me what you're looking for, and I'll send homes that fit as soon as they hit the market.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Angelina Gándara ("we", "our") collects, uses, and protects information you provide through this website, including any forms and chat features.
privacy.collectBody: We collect information you voluntarily provide, such as your name, email address, phone number, property address, and details about your real estate goals when you complete a form, book a call, or message us.
privacy.useBody: We use your information to respond to your inquiries, provide real estate services, schedule appointments, and share listings or valuations you request. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.shareBody: Forms and chat on this site are powered by GoHighLevel, our client-relationship system. Information you submit is stored there so we can serve you. We may share information with the broker, Home Pros Real Estate Group LLC, as needed to provide services.
privacy.cookiesBody: This site does not use advertising or analytics cookies. Our client-relationship system may place cookies that are strictly necessary to operate its forms, chat, and calendar features.
privacy.rightsBody: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us using the details below.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy questions, email gandara.realtor@gmail.com or call (915) 355-0494.

terms.accuracyBody: Any home value estimate is an estimate, not an appraisal, and is provided for information only. Listings and market data shown are placeholders until a live MLS search is available.
terms.representationBody: Angelina Gándara is a licensed real estate sales agent under Home Pros Real Estate Group LLC. Using this website does not create an agency relationship. A representation agreement is required for brokerage services.
terms.liabilityBody: To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damages arising from your use of this site or reliance on its content.
terms.governingBody: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Texas, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
terms.contactBody: Questions about these terms? Email gandara.realtor@gmail.com or call (915) 355-0494.
